scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the expected phase boundary from the reported condensate fraction and noncondensate spin density using the analytic formulas (Eqs. 35,36,38,40) and compares to the reported boundary; a full recompute from raw intermediate solver outputs is not possible because the solver's intermediate state is not output, but the analytic consistency provides a strong load-bearing recompute from the agent's own numerical data.

outputs.description: AFM-FM phase boundary data as a function of temperature. The checker recomputes the expected boundary from n^c/n and F_z^{nc}/n using the analytic formulas for full and truncated HF and verifies consistency.

BA-P phase boundary data as a function of temperature. The checker recomputes the expected boundary from n^c/n and d^{nc}/n using the analytic formulas for full and truncated HF and verifies consistency.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the HF solver from scratch. The analytic consistency check serves as a strong load-bearing mechanism: the reported numbers must satisfy the derived relations. The phase boundary search requires root-finding over p or q.

steps.description: Check consistency of AFM-FM boundary with analytic formulas Eq. 35 and Eq. 36.
Check consistency of BA-P boundary with analytic formulas Eq. 38 and Eq. 40.
